pos.personaBrief: Verified: Ajax controlled possession and 'retained the ball for a long time' against Milan in the 1995 final (single match); the team is built to have the ball, not to concede it and counter.

pro.personaBrief: Verified: progression 'relied mostly on the speed of their passing in simple combinations' and long retention, with some vertical passes that were lost; patient short build-up from the back, but quick passing rather than sterile circulation.

est.personaBrief: Verified: a 3-3-4 structure in possession that 'occupied the back line very well while controlling the center', i.e. fixed, spread positional occupation; wide players held width while the forwards linked play.

lar.personaBrief: Verified: the 3-3-4 occupied the whole back line and Finidi on the wing receiving from Reiziger was a key outlet; the team relied on two genuine wingers (Finidi, Overmars) holding width.

blo.personaBrief: Pressing is a research gap (no verified source); from general knowledge Van Gaal's Ajax defended high and pressed immediately after losing the ball, consistent with the verified dominant possession game in the opponent's half.

mar.personaBrief: No verified evidence (gap); from general knowledge Ajax defended by spaces within a high, compact positional structure rather than dedicated man-markers, with aggressive pressing on whoever entered the zone.

pla.personaBrief: No verified stated view (gap); from general knowledge Van Gaal imposed a fixed game model and played it against everyone, consistent with the verified 3-3-4 possession game used even against Milan in the final.

res.personaBrief: No verified evidence (gap); from general knowledge Van Gaal valued winning through his process, playing to win everywhere, while the final itself was won 1-0 with long possession rather than spectacle.

sis.personaBrief: No verified evidence (gap); from general knowledge Van Gaal's Ajax was a system-first team where every player, stars included, had a defined role, consistent with the rehearsed 3-3-4 structure that was verified.

jog.personaBrief: No verified evidence (gap); from general knowledge the team prioritised technique and passing (consistent with verified fast combination play) while also demanding work rate and athleticism from everyone.

bas.personaBrief: Verified: starting XI averaged 22 (24 with the experienced defenders), 18-year-old Kluivert scored the final winner; the unverified count says 13 of 18 came from the academy, with Rijkaard and Blind as the experienced core.

lid.personaBrief: No verified evidence on people management (gap); from general knowledge Van Gaal ran the group with strict discipline and the coach's final word, applied equally to everyone.
